meta.title: Stranded in Prehistory
meta.subtitle: A time experiment goes wrong, and now you're trapped in the age of dinosaurs.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 🔬 The Experiment
scenes.narrative:
You stand in a research lab staring at a glowing time device.

The test was supposed to be small… controlled.

Instead, the machine overloads.

A blinding flash.

Silence.

You wake up in a dense jungle.

Something massive roars in the distance.

scenes.title: 🌳 The Jungle
scenes.narrative:
The air is thick and humid. Giant plants surround you.

Footprints the size of your body press into the mud nearby.

You are not in your time anymore.

scenes.title: 😨 Panic
scenes.narrative:
You sprint through the jungle blindly.

Branches snap. The ground shakes.

Something is chasing you.

scenes.title: ⚡ Up High
scenes.narrative:
You scramble up a tree just in time.

A massive T-Rex stomps below, sniffing the air.

It eventually leaves.

You’re safe… for now.

scenes.title: 🦖 The Predator
scenes.narrative:
You follow the footprints… and immediately regret it.

A T-Rex stands ahead, feeding.

It hasn’t noticed you yet.

scenes.title: 🏔 Cliffside
scenes.narrative:
You climb to higher ground.

From here, you see herds of dinosaurs moving across the land.

In the distance… something metallic.

It looks like part of your machine.

scenes.title: 🐢 The Herd
scenes.narrative:
A group of massive herbivores move together peacefully.

They don’t seem aggressive… but something startles them.

The ground begins to shake.

scenes.title: 📽 Hidden Tech
scenes.narrative:
You hide near a strange metal object buried in the dirt.

It’s part of your time device.

It’s still active… barely.

scenes.title: 🌥 Crash Site
scenes.narrative:
You find the remains of your time machine.

It’s damaged, but parts still glow.

This might be your only way home.

scenes.title: 🎋 Survival
scenes.narrative:
You gather materials: sticks, stones, anything useful.

You feel slightly more prepared.

But the jungle is getting louder.

scenes.title: ⚓ Final Choice
scenes.narrative:
You manage to partially repair the device.

It sparks to life.

You can go home… or change something.

scenes.title: ☠️ Caught
scenes.narrative:
You run, but you are not fast enough.

The predator catches you.

This is where your story ends.

scenes.title: 🐤 Trampled
scenes.narrative:
The herd panics.

You are caught in the stampede.

There is no escape.

scenes.title: 👑 New Life
scenes.narrative:
You build a shelter and survive.

Days turn into months.

You adapt to this world.

You are no longer just a visitor—you belong here now.

scenes.title: 🌈 Back Home
scenes.narrative:
The device activates.

You are pulled through time.

You wake up back in your lab.

Everything is normal… except you know what’s out there.

scenes.title: 🧴 The Scientist
scenes.narrative:
You choose to stay.

You study dinosaurs firsthand.

Your knowledge could rewrite history… if you ever return.

scenes.title: 🌫 Time Collapse
scenes.narrative:
You overload the machine.

Time fractures around you.

Past, present, and future collide.

You exist everywhere… and nowhere.
